comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 3a9441f and manuals/README.md. The module has no inputs at all; everything arrives over MIDI. Pitch bend is scaled as 4 times the 14-bit value minus 8192 over 8191, so a full bend is 4V or 48 semitones, the MPE default. Note pitch is the MIDI note number minus 60 over 12. The two menu-only settings, Gate Velocity Mode and Preserve Pitch after Note-Off, are parameters with no widget and cannot be clicked. The envelope switches between three laws on note-off by the note's length: under 0.125 seconds it uses the decay screw, over 0.1875 seconds the release screw, and between them a blend of the two.
